references.text: The same threat of curse and destruction from the Lord for disobedience, including confusion and sickness as punishment.
An introduction to the curses that come upon those who do not obey the Lord's commands, as verse 20 elaborates.
Repeats the theme of curses that come because of disobedience to the voice and commands of the Lord.
The Lord will abandon the people, and evil things will strike them because they have abandoned him.
A prophetic warning of destruction because the people left the Lord and chose what is evil.
The Lord's wrath and curse are poured out on the disobedient, with a threat of annihilation.
The Lord threatens to send a curse upon the priests if they do not honor his name.
